task_message:
Case N04: segment the peripheral nerve sheath tumor on this T2-weighted MRI.

Volume: 121x121x111 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.
final_assistant_text:
Finished case N04.

**Result:** peripheral nerve sheath tumor segmented as a single 5.7 mL component (axial 63–100, coronal 53–70, sagittal 36–54; 1 mm isotropic).

**Approach:**
- Reviewed axial, coronal and sagittal sheets to localize the markedly T2-hyperintense, fusiform mass lying against the bone cortex, distinct from the small skin marker and the linear fascial/vascular bright planes.
- Seeded the model with a positive point at the lesion centre on the axial slice where it is largest, then applied a `seg_refine` pass (6.0 → 5.7 mL) to tighten the boundary.
- Verified coverage at both poles and all three planes with zoomed mask overlays (axial 62/66/91/93/98, coronal 62, sagittal 38/46/50), confirmed no lesion tissue in the past-the-end review slices and found no suspected missed components (`seg_candidates`: none).

**Confidence: medium** — the outline follows the lesion boundary cleanly in all three planes; the only residual uncertainty is the extent of the faint inferior tapering tail and the ill-defined superior pole, both of which are included.
